rca of the issue: Prior code passed user-supplied q directly into Mongo $regex, making metacharacters like '.*' act as wildcards (matching everything) and invalid patterns like '(' potentially raising. Fix wraps q with re.escape() so it is treated as a literal substring, preserving case-insensitive substring behavior via $options: 'i'.
